document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (3): run pull request CI for documentation-only changes

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request docs/macos-testers before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of the change that removes paths-ignore: '**.md' from the pull_request trigger in .github/workflows/pr-pull.yaml, plus README documentation edits. No security issues found.

notes.title: Why the change was made
notes.text: The Protect main ruleset requires the formatting and build checks on every pull request. The template skipped the pull request workflow when only Markdown files changed, so the required checks never reported and documentation-only pull requests could never be merged.

notes.title: Audit details
notes.text: Reviewed: .github/workflows/pr-pull.yaml and the workflows it calls (check-format.yaml, build-project.yaml). The workflow still uses the pull_request event (not pull_request_target), so pull requests from forks get a read-only token and no repository secrets; macOS signing secrets stay empty for them. Token permissions stay contents: read. GitHub's default setting for public repositories requires maintainer approval before workflows run for first-time contributors. Pull requests that changed code already ran this same workflow, so the change adds no new exposure; it only makes documentation-only pull requests run it too. The README changes contain no code or links to executable content.

notes.title: Result
notes.text: No findings. Logged as required by the project's audit policy.
